title: Classifying an Exceptional Four-Item Incidence in Binary Latent Causal Models with Two Latents
banked_reason: D0.5 graded the sound per-law fiber certificate incremental, below the field floor (paper score ceiling 5.9 < 7.4); global all-11 component geometry and unresolved positive strata remain open.
gap_reasons: The TL;DR's claim that the exceptional incidence is classified therefore exceeds the delivered structural characterization, because nonemptiness of the complementary-pair and pure-3/pure-4 strata and exclusion of all-11 components above dimension four remain open.

The contraction/IFT argument proves only a four-dimensional smooth local fiber patch near the witness, not that its semialgebraically connected all-11 component has dimension exactly four; a larger connected component remains expressly unresolved by the OEQ.
The dependent-latents restriction is not consumed.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived a fixed-incidence pencil, a seven-stratum reduction, per-law CAD certificates, a local positive all-11 patch, and a fifth-item repair boundary. D0.5 judged this package incremental below the required field floor; the advertised global all-11 component and positive-stratum classification remained open. The math panel also requested removal of an unused dependent-latents assumption and correction of a local-to-global component claim, so the full note has not passed soundness review.
tldr: The exceptional four-item incidence \((10,01,11,11)\) is classified against one explicit disjoint universe of positive faithful one- and two-binary-latent alternatives. The fixed-incidence curve is quotiented only by its incidence stabilizer; observable flattenings and the classical sextic reduce the two-latent alternatives to seven strata; pair, one-pure, and finitely indexed all-\(11\) polynomial charts yield a terminating sound and complete exact-real certificate with an explicit certificate-length bound; and a relatively open all-\(11\) collision region gives robust nonidentification. For the repair, every informative fifth row \(10,01,11\) is identified over the strictly broader Lee--Gu published BLCM universe, without this note's measurement-cell interior restriction, while over the explicit regular classes \(\mathcal M_+(r)\) the null row \(00\) and only that row preserves the four-item pencil ambiguity.
gap: Lee and Gu, arXiv:2505.18410v2, Section 3.1, Definition 3 and equation (2), require two triangular blocks, while Theorem 2 requires a third block with no empty column and Definition 4 imposes the subset condition; Section 3.2 supplies separate necessities. Culpepper (2023), Psychometrika 88, pp. 158--174, permits saturated dyads through dyad-completeness but its Kruskal route requires \(J>2K\), as recorded in Gu (2026), Section 3.1. The exceptional design has \(J=4=2K\), so both published routes leave its positive faithful arbitrary-incidence union fiber unresolved.
fill: The project gives a finite if-and-only-if certificate for the positive faithful arbitrary-incidence union at \(J=2K\), exposes the global dimension-compression step as an open question, and proves the exact minimal one-item repair uniformly over the explicitly quantified class \(\mathcal M_+(r)\).
